summary: The acid-dip caller passes numeric 0 as erode_obj’s optional description. C passes a null pointer, so erode_obj substitutes cxname(obj); JavaScript’s nullish fallback treats 0 as an explicit description and prints “Your 0 corrodes!” instead of “Your dagger corrodes!”. The source-backed correction is to pass null at potion.c:potion_dip’s acid arm.

source.branch: After water, polymorph, potion-mixture, lichen-corpse, towel, and poison-coating branches, POT_ACID calls erode_obj(obj, NULL, ERODE_CORRODE, EF_GREASE). A non-greased corrodeable carried dagger reaches erode_obj’s name fallback and corrosion message.
callers: potion.c:dodip selects the target and potion, then calls potion_dip; js/potion.js dodip and altdip dispatch to the shared potion_dip implementation.
potion.c:potion_dip calls trap.c:erode_obj with a null description; js/potion.js calls js/trap_erode_obj.js:erode_obj with numeric 0.
dependencies: trap.c:erode_obj is already implemented and uses description ?? cxname(obj); its source contract is correct for null and undefined callers.

evidence: Evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261007043256-v25.json at e61af74e9cd0087d730c364dcc8488bf0702ad32 records 54/55 matching screens, 2,652/2,652 RNG calls, and 54/55 cursors. The first mismatch is segment 0 step 50 after key q: C prints “Your dagger corrodes!--More--” and JavaScript prints “Your 0 corrodes!--More--”.

Upstream potion.c:2638-2642 calls erode_obj(obj, 0, ERODE_CORRODE, EF_GREASE). In C, integer constant 0 is a null pointer constant for the const char * parameter. trap.c:232-233 replaces a null ostr with cxname(otmp).
JavaScript js/potion.js:3573-3574 passes numeric 0. js/trap_erode_obj.js:211 uses description ?? cxname(obj), so 0 survives the fallback and becomes the printed item description.

The smallest general correction is the potion_dip acid-arm argument from 0 to null, with source-pinned singular and plural/protected wording tests and independent acid-dip recordings. It does not reopen whole potion_dip or erode_obj source completion.
